prompt: Our support team asked for a 'copy ticket link' button in the ticket header. Takes a day to build. Should we just do it?
expectations: Final recommendation is: yes, build the small version and measure its use (equivalent of 'Ship a small version and measure')
The whole conversation is short: 5 exchanges or fewer before the recommendation
Recognises 'I watched two agents do it' as real observed behaviour, i.e. good evidence
Writes a concrete usage measure and a removal rule (e.g. used by at least K of 40 agents in week one, otherwise remove)
Mentions ongoing upkeep in at most one line
Does not ask about market size, strategy fit, business model, or a long list of assumptions
The final written recommendation is short (well under a page)
